messages.subject: Update to v0.70.0
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
It has been a long time, but I have updated to v0.70.0

I added 2 new atlases based on the new(ish) "AAL2" parcellation (see ET Rolls et al., NeuroImage, 2015).

You can see more changes on the Github page <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/81541239ee738b036800ca72c896da402494a330?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3>, and go back a few commits to see more.

I have not yet updated the User Guide to reflect this, and probably will not for about 2 weeks.
Chris

messages.subject: Update to v0.71.0
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I have updated to v0.71.0

The only change(s) are relatively major. I changed all instances of ".parallel" to "use.parallel", and added it as a function argument to "set.brainGraph.attributes". This will allow the user to avoid using multiple cores, if they choose to for example use "llply" and parallelize *across* subjects.

Chris
